summary_1line: Ravana surveys besieged Lanka as Rama’s monkey army assaults the city gates and Ravana orders the titans to launch a counterattack.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands on the palace height gazing over Lanka as endless brown waves of monkeys surround the city from every side.
Monkeys roar and hurl rocks and uprooted trees against the golden gates and battlements of Lanka while shouting victory to Rama.
War drums with moon‑white faces thunder across Lanka as the titan army prepares to sortie from the city gates.
